changeSet.author: grushton

preConditions.onFailMessage: file_storage_object must have 3 timestamp or timestamptz column(s): create_date, delete_date, update_date. Compare the deployed schema with the changesets before you deploy.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = current_schema() AND table_name = 'file_storage_object' AND column_name IN ('create_date', 'delete_date', 'update_date') AND data_type IN ('timestamp without time zone', 'timestamp with time zone')

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE file_storage_object ALTER COLUMN create_date TYPE timestamp with time zone, ALTER COLUMN delete_date TYPE timestamp with time zone, ALTER COLUMN update_date TYPE timestamp with time zone

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE file_storage_object ALTER COLUMN create_date TYPE timestamp without time zone, ALTER COLUMN delete_date TYPE timestamp without time zone, ALTER COLUMN update_date TYPE timestamp without time zone
